risk_if_not_implemented: Without Resource Containment, adversaries may move laterally, exfiltrate data or reach systems that should have been isolated from untrusted networks. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to System / Data Compromise (Technical Vector) (R-BC-4), Delayed Containment / Increased Incident Impact (R-IR-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Human Error (MT-9), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Network Intrusion Detection / Prevention Systems (NIDS / NIPS)
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to employ Network Intrusion Detection / Prevention Systems (NIDS/NIPS) to detect and/or prevent intrusions into the network.
compensating_control_1.justification: Network Intrusion Detection / Prevention Systems (NIDS / NIPS) (NET-31) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Resource Containment (NET-44) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Boundary Protection
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to monitor and control communications at the external network boundary and at key internal boundaries within the network.
compensating_control_2.justification: Boundary Protection (NET-03) provides network-level access restriction that compensates for the absence of Resource Containment (NET-44) by limiting attacker reach and lateral movement opportunities across the environment. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
